title: Ojousama o Nerae!!
overview:
I want to give it only to you...

The sensual romance adventure that was a big hit on PC arrives on the Sega Saturn! During the last summer vacation of high school, can you make your romance with a young lady of good family bear fruit? The voice cast features popular video actresses including Hitomi Yuuki, Maiko Yuuki, Momoka Suzuki, Rina Kitahara, Youko Yazawa, Kanako Fujimori and Ayano Natsuki, for plenty of presence.

あなただけに　あげたい・・・

パソコン版で大ヒットしたあの官能恋愛アドベンチャーがセガサターンに登場！高校最後の夏休み、果たしてお嬢様との恋を実らすことができるのか。声優陣には憂木瞳、夕樹舞子、涼木もも香、北原梨奈、矢沢ようこ、藤森加奈子、夏木あやのなどの人気ビデオ女優を起用し、臨場感たっぷりです。
